reviewed_by: Claude: MCP inline output previews and cancelled notification, focused backend selection
reason: MCP tool results were artifact-only: tool_results previews accepted only stdout/stderr refs, so text MCP output never reached the model inline. Plain-text MCP blocks now become previews (kind mcp_text) with the same caps and redaction as stdout; structured stdout/stderr/output strings are stored as text artifacts and previewed when the text does not fit; images are never previewed. A timed-out or cancelled tools/call now sends notifications/cancelled with the request id and, for stdio, closes stdin and waits up to MCP_CANCEL_GRACE_SECONDS before the existing close. Selected: the new regression file (previews, redaction, partial bounds, image exclusion, structured fields, description, stdio timeout/cancel/stubborn server, HTTP timeout), the MCP transport suite, the storage and partial-preview contracts the recorder shares, the tool catalog directory that strips the receipt note, the harness gateway MCP receipt test updated for the new preview, and the product knowledge discovery and Chroma digest sync checks for the docs/MCP-SERVERS.md section.
exclusions: No frontend, native or Playwright tests: the UI does not consume the tool receipt's output_preview kind and no interface changed. tests/v3/test_harnesses.py is selected by test name; test_knowledge_access_change_refreshes_fixed_gateway_catalog fails on origin/main without this change. The HTTP/SSE cancel path is covered by a mock-transport unit test only. No full-suite approval.
